acquisition.censored_measurements: Keep inequality relations as bounds; exact-point regression labels require the declared exact-value policy.
acquisition.compatibility: Define the experimental question first. Preserve mutants, cellular outcomes and different assay protocols separately.
acquisition.continuity_candidate_only: CHEMBL3095060; compatibility, compound count and scaffold diversity require actual verification
acquisition.endpoint: Exact IC50 in nM, transformed to pIC50 only after unit, relation and positivity checks
acquisition.missingness: Keep missing context explicit. Retain every exclusion and its reason. A missing value is not zero.
acquisition.policy: First investigate a bounded multi-compound collection from one compatible human wild-type EGFR biochemical assay
acquisition.replicates: Preserve original records and group their chemical identity; any within-condition aggregation needs a predeclared justified policy.
retain: retrieval UTC and public source URL
raw and standardized endpoint, value, units and relation
acquisition.rights: Preserve ChEMBL/EMBL-EBI attribution and CC BY-SA 3.0 terms for redistributed or adapted data; paper rights remain separate.

comparison.baseline: Training-mean predictor on the exact same held-out rows as each candidate model
comparison.candidate_models: Choose transparent, task-appropriate models in Part 7; any additional package requires approval
comparison.learned_preprocessing: Fit imputation, scaling, selection or target transforms within training folds; apply those learned transforms to held-out inputs
metrics: R squared with held-out-reference mean denominator
Spearman with average ranks for ties
retain: exact command, runtime/package versions and settings
variation across justified repeats when feasible
comparison.undefined_cases: Preserve constant-reference R squared or constant-vector Spearman as undefined with a reason

diagnostics: nearest training-neighbour similarity using fixed representation settings
activity-cliff examples if compatible measured evidence supports them
coverage_and_limits.domain_rule: Calibrate any coverage/uncertainty rule with appropriate held-out or out-of-fold evidence; a universal similarity cutoff is not assumed
coverage_and_limits.future_screening_handoff: Pass model/split/metric definitions and applicability limits to Part 8 only after the actual Part 7 run
coverage_and_limits.interpretation: The result estimates the specified assay endpoint within the evaluated scope. Experimental confirmation and other development endpoints are separate evidence.

current_evidence.part4: One separate retained erlotinib assay record; the 209-row raw collection contains only erlotinib across 209 assays
current_evidence.part5: Eight unique structural teaching identities; feature matrix has no activity labels and is not training-ready

features_and_identity.chemistry_policy: Declare salts/components, stereochemistry, protonation and tautomer handling; preserve raw inputs and transformations
features_and_identity.exact_identity_groups: Keep aliases, replicate records and the same declared chemical identity within one partition
features_and_identity.feature_order: Save feature names, units, toolkit/version and fingerprint family, radius, length, chirality and other settings
features_and_identity.recipe: Start from the recorded Part 5 identity and representation settings and reassess them against the acquired task

partition_design.freeze_before_fitting: Retain immutable row/identity assignments, seed, grouping algorithm and dataset hashes
partition_design.random: A within-collection interpolation question; report train/test identity and nearest-neighbour overlap
partition_design.scaffold: A declared structural-framework stress test, conditional on enough useful groups; different cores may still be similar
partition_design.study: A study or assay-group transfer question only if that endpoint combination is scientifically justified
partition_design.test: Use held-out references for the final stated comparison after model choices are frozen
partition_design.time: Use trustworthy experimental/availability timestamps when present; label publication-year splits as a proxy
partition_design.training: Fit model parameters and the mean baseline using training labels
partition_design.unavailable_design: Record why a proposed split is unsupported; do not invent timestamps, scaffolds, extra datasets or a performance gap
partition_design.validation: Choose model settings and learned preprocessing using training/validation folds; refit transforms inside each training fold
